nodes.description: Address of the privileged owner of the Owned contract; set from msg.sender in the constructor and guarded by onlyOwner.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to JBX in the JudgmentCoin constructor.
Public token name string, set to JudgmentCoin in the constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public _totalSupply holding 100000000000000000000000000 minted at construction.
mapping(address => uint) balances tracking per-account token holdings.
Nested allowance mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed used by approve/transferFrom.
Ballot chairperson address; set to msg.sender and used as the access-control anchor.
mapping(address => Voter) voters storing weight, voted flag, vote index and delegate.
Dynamic Proposal[] proposals array holding voteCount per proposal.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returns c = a + b with a require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) requires b <= a before returning a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) with division-based overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) requires b > 0 before dividing.
Owned() constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner; stages newOwner.
acceptOwnership() requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred, promotes owner and clears newOwner.
JudgmentCoin() constructor setting metadata, total supply and minting all tokens to a fixed address.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) decrements balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], then credits balances[to].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) sets allowance then invokes ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts so ETH is not accepted.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
Ballot(uint8 _numProposals) constructor setting chairperson = msg.sender, giving weight 1 and sizing proposals array.
giveRightToVote(address toVoter) returns early unless msg.sender == chairperson and voter has not voted, then sets weight = 1.
delegate(address to) follows a delegation chain in an unbounded while loop and adds sender.weight to the target's weight or voteCount.
vote(uint8 toProposal) marks voters[msg.sender] voted and adds its weight to proposals[toProposal].voteCount.
winningProposal() iterates proposals and returns the index with the largest voteCount.
msg.sender in the token contracts: attacker-controlled caller used for ownership, allowances and balance debits.
msg.sender in Ballot: caller identity used for chairperson assignment and for indexing voters[msg.sender].
Unchecked addition proposals[delegateTo.vote].voteCount += sender.weight inside delegate().
Unchecked addition delegateTo.weight += sender.weight inside delegate().
Unchecked addition proposals[toProposal].voteCount += sender.weight inside vote().
Direct array length assignment proposals.length = _numProposals in the Ballot constructor, which can enlarge storage arbitrarily.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to a caller-supplied contract inside approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract inside transferAnyERC20Token.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() that bypasses SafeMath.
Unbounded while loop walking the delegation chain in delegate(), allowing gas exhaustion / DoS on long chains.
Parameter a of SafeMath.safeAdd, the left operand of the guarded addition.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, written into the newOwner state variable.
Parameter _numProposals of the Ballot constructor, assigned to proposals.length.
Parameter to of Ballot.delegate, mutated while walking the delegation chain.
Parameter toProposal of Ballot.vote, used as the proposals array index.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, used both as allowance key and as external call target.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall, written into the allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
Storage reference Voter storage sender = voters[msg.sender] inside Ballot.delegate.
Storage reference Voter storage delegateTo = voters[to] inside Ballot.delegate.
uint256 winningVoteCount accumulator in winningProposal.
uint8 loop counter prop iterating over proposals in winningProposal.

edges.reason: Owned() constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role from an untrusted caller.
msg.sender of the deployment call becomes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner after checking msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the two-step transfer.
JudgmentCoin constructor sets symbol = 'JBX'.
JudgmentCoin constructor sets name = 'JudgmentCoin'.
JudgmentCoin constructor sets decimals = 18.
JudgmentCoin constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed total.
JudgmentCoin constructor mints the entire supply into balances of a fixed address.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)] outside SafeMath.
totalSupply() performs the unchecked subtraction that is modelled as an unsafe operation.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] through safeSub/safeAdd.
approve writes the requested amount into allowed[msg.sender][spender] without resetting to zero.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to] through SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] by tokens.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before making the external call.
approveAndCall passes control to the attacker-supplied spender contract via receiveApproval.
The external receiveApproval invocation is a callback into untrusted code while the function is still executing.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards the call to an owner-supplied token contract.
The arbitrary ERC20 transfer call is an external callback that can re-enter the owner-gated function.
Ballot constructor sets chairperson = msg.sender.
Ballot constructor sets voters[chairperson].weight = 1.
Ballot constructor sizes proposals via proposals.length = _numProposals.
giveRightToVote mutates voters[toVoter].weight only when msg.sender == chairperson.
delegate reads and writes Voter storage records in the voters mapping.
delegate adds sender.weight to proposals[delegateTo.vote].voteCount without SafeMath.
delegate adds sender.weight to delegateTo.weight without SafeMath.
delegate's while loop chases the delegation chain with no bound on iterations.
vote reads/writes the caller's Voter record in voters.
vote adds sender.weight to proposals[toProposal].voteCount without SafeMath.
winningProposal loops over the proposals array comparing voteCount.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
transferFrom spends the allowance keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
Ballot chairperson is derived from msg.sender at construction time.
giveRightToVote compares msg.sender against chairperson to decide whether to return early.
delegate acts on voters[msg.sender] and uses msg.sender in the delegation-loop guard.
vote acts on voters[msg.sender] and refuses repeat voting.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller identity determines the affected balance.
transfer delegates the debit arithmetic to safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit arithmetic to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance debits to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the recipient credit to safeAdd.
Parameter a of safeAdd feeds the guarded addition whose result is checked against a.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
_numProposals parameter directly sets proposals.length in the Ballot constructor.
to parameter is repeatedly reassigned while resolving the delegation chain.
toProposal parameter indexes proposals and only the length of the array bounds it.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the target contract of the external call.
tokens parameter is written into the allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
sender storage reference aliases voters[msg.sender] for mutation inside delegate.
delegateTo storage reference aliases voters[to] for weight/voteCount updates.
winningVoteCount local tracks the highest voteCount seen while scanning proposals.
prop loop counter indexes the proposals array in winningProposal.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a only exists as the operand of SafeMath.safeAdd and has no meaning outside that helper function.
_newOwner is only used to populate the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
_numProposals is consumed immediately to set proposals.length in the Ballot constructor.
The to parameter is local to the delegation loop logic of delegate.
toProposal is only used to index proposals within vote.
spender is used only as the allowance key and external call target inside approveAndCall.
tokens is only written into the allowance and forwarded by approveAndCall.
The sender storage reference is a temporary alias for voters[msg.sender] inside delegate.
The delegateTo storage reference is a temporary alias for voters[to] inside delegate.
winningVoteCount is a scratch accumulator used only during the winningProposal scan.
prop is a loop counter confined to the winningProposal iteration.
